features.text: 新增 Windows x64 与 Linux x64 的 managed 安装、更新检查、管理员确认安装、维护栅栏、失败回滚和独立重启验证。
新增可重定位双平台制品、结构化双语发布说明、未签名候选证据和重建摘要校验流程。

fixes.text: 修复更新切换、SQLite WAL 快照、进程身份、当前版本链接切换和中断恢复中的竞态。
完善根路径与 /fs/ 子路径配置，并为 index.html、SPA fallback 和失效静态资源设置正确缓存边界。

security.text: 内部更新健康与提交通道使用 attempt/fence 绑定的短时 capability；归档、路径、凭据和文件权限保持 fail closed。
发布必须校验精确候选提交、运行 ID、双平台 SHA-256、固定公钥和受保护签名环境。

upgrades.text: 旧式源码部署必须先停止全部旧进程并按 UPDATING.md 手动 bootstrap；升级不得让旧、新版本同时写同一数据库或存储。
发布归档同时提供 current/apps/web/dist-root 与 dist-fs；Nginx 按根路径或 /fs/ 选择对应目录，Docker 内禁止自更新或挂载 Docker socket。

known_issues.text: 0.2.5 首个 managed updater 不自动替换自身，协议或 updater 版本不兼容时会要求手动 bootstrap/upgrade。
2026-10-28 registry 快照的 full audit 为 4 Critical、7 High、25 Moderate、9 Low，production 为 1 Critical、5 High、19 Moderate；Critical/High 处置或明确风险接受前发布保持 blocked。

features.text: Add Windows x64 and Linux x64 managed installs, update checks, administrator-confirmed installation, maintenance fencing, rollback, and independent restart verification.
Add relocatable dual-platform artifacts, structured bilingual notes, unsigned candidate provenance, and rebuilt digest verification.

fixes.text: Fix races in update switching, SQLite WAL snapshots, process identity, current-link changes, and interrupted recovery.
Complete root and /fs/ deployments with correct cache boundaries for index.html, SPA fallback, and stale static assets.

security.text: Bind internal update health and promote routes to short-lived attempt/fence capabilities while keeping archives, paths, credentials, and file permissions fail closed.
Require the exact candidate commit, run ID, both platform SHA-256 digests, fixed public key, and protected signing environment.

upgrades.text: Legacy source deployments must stop every old process and follow UPDATING.md for a one-time bootstrap; old and new versions must never write the same database or storage concurrently.

Release archives include both current/apps/web/dist-root and dist-fs; point Nginx at the selected deployment path. Docker installations must use documented manual image updates and must not self-update or mount the Docker socket.

known_issues.text: The first managed updater in 0.2.5 does not replace itself; incompatible protocols or updater versions require manual bootstrap or upgrade guidance.

The 2026-10-28 registry snapshot has 4 Critical, 7 High, 25 Moderate, and 9 Low findings for the full tree, and 1 Critical, 5 High, and 19 Moderate for production; publication remains blocked until Critical/High findings are resolved or explicitly accepted.
